# czc-v2026.10.22.5 (0.2.17.22)

GPT requests on OpenAI OAuth accounts no longer fail with
`codex synthesis: request exceeds the model context window` while the real
context is far below the model limit.

## Changes since czc-v2026.10.22.4

### Codex full synthesis

- **Official Codex clients are no longer rebuilt.** Codex CLI / Desktop /
  VS Code / SDK clients configured with a custom `model_provider` (as when
  pointed at this gateway) strip `internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough`,
  so the `model.base_instructions` marker was missing. Because they declare
  `exec_command` / `apply_patch`, they were classified as "compatible" and got
  a second base prompt plus the synthesis budget check. Requests whose
  User-Agent / originator identify an official Codex client are now treated
  as native and forwarded as before synthesis existed. 91 of the 93
  `exceeds the model context window` errors logged today came from official
  Codex clients (15 users; gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-6-astra
  and others), including 10 after czc-v2026.10.22.4 was deployed.
- **The budget uses the advertised context window.** The check used the
  pinned catalog `context_window` (272k for every GPT model) minus a 25%
  reserve, about 204k, while `/models` advertises 500k for gpt-6.1-sol (872k
  max). Clients compact against the advertised window, so they never
  compacted before the gateway refused them. Limits are now resolved in the
  same order as `/models`: synced account metadata, the configured Codex
  descriptor, the pinned catalog, then the 272k fallback. Past the
  advertised window the gateway trims optional synthesized context (skills,
  permissions) and still forwards; it rejects only past
  `max_context_window`. The 25% reserve is removed.
- **`encrypted_content` is excluded from the estimate.** Reasoning and
  compaction replay blobs were counted as base64 text at 4 bytes/token.
- **Overflow returns a standard error.** A real overflow now returns HTTP 400
  `invalid_request_error` with `code: context_length_exceeded` (Responses and
  Chat Completions) or `prompt is too long: ...` (Anthropic Messages), so
  clients can auto-compact. The Responses path marks the response committed
  so the handler no longer appends a second `response.failed` event with
  `code: upstream_error` after the JSON body.

## VERSION

`0.2.17.22`

## Upgrade guidance

Drop-in, no database migration and no configuration change.

## Compatibility

- Official Codex clients get the pre-synthesis behavior on OpenAI OAuth
  accounts (same as before czc-v2026.10.22.1). Accounts with an explicit
  `codex_client_capability` extra still follow that override.
- Generic clients (opencode, Kilo, WorkBuddy, SDKs) still get full synthesis;
  only the budget thresholds and error shape change.
- SetupToken, API-key and non-OpenAI accounts are unaffected.

## Verification

Passed:

- `gofmt -l` on the changed Go files: clean.
- `go vet ./internal/service/`.
- `go test -count=1 ./...` (see release check below).
- New tests in `codex_synth_context_budget_test.go`: gpt-6.1-sol limits equal
  the advertised 500k / 872k, account metadata override, fallback for unknown
  models, a ~300k-token conversation is accepted, `encrypted_content` is not
  charged, an official Codex Desktop request without the marker is not
  rebuilt, and an oversized request returns `context_length_exceeded` with the
  response marked committed.
- Updated `TestCodexSynthesisTrimsOptionalContextBeforeFailing` (trim past the
  advertised window, reject only past the hard limit) and the image estimate
  test.

Failed or skipped:

- The `-tags unit` service suite was not re-run; the 12 pre-existing failures
  listed in the czc-v2026.10.22.2 notes are unrelated to this change.
- golangci-lint is not installed locally; not run.
- Frontend source is unchanged; it was rebuilt only for the embed build.
- No live replay of a failing request: request bodies are not stored, so the
  exact pre-fix estimate for the logged failures could not be reproduced.

## Rollback

Redeploy `czc-v2026.10.22.4`, or restore the backup
`/opt/sub2api/sub2api.bak.czc-v2026.10.22.5-<UTC timestamp>` created during
this deploy and restart `sub2api.service`. As a config-only mitigation,
`gateway.codex_full_synthesis: false` disables synthesis entirely.
